usedFor: Campaign Monitor collects your email subscribers, and HubSpot opens a sales record through “Create Deal” for each one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber” in Campaign Monitor, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Sales sees each new sign-up as a deal in HubSpot, without anyone copying names across.

watchOut: “New Subscriber” is polling, so deals arrive after a scheduled check rather than at sign-up.
